notes.title: Latest Patch Including Performance Updates...
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We need to address a few issues. We have been working on performance updates, making progress, but not totally completed. Sometimes the game will not respond as you load into matches or change maps, just be patient and you will be all set.

On Other notes, we have fixed the UAV killstreak and changed the material of the Marine soldier so that you can now distinguish the two teams apart.

Thank you :smile_eol:

notes.title: Flash Point is Going Free to Play
notes.notes:
Hello,

As our title reads, we will be going F2P very shortly. This goes as a plan to gain more players and to generate a larger community. To our paid players, we think you will enjoy the potential jump in playerbase. We are not doing this to bother anyone, but to benefit the game as whole. We hope you understand. ;)

notes.title: Flash Point - Huge Update
notes.notes:
Hello!

We have been working extra hard on improving the game. With a new art style, and many bug fixes, expect much more from Flash Point. See the changelist below:

[*] Improved in-game HUD
[*] Brand new art style
[*] New Skins
[*] Skins Progress window at Main Menu
[*] New map Space Hangar

notes.title: Flash Point Has Been Released
notes.notes:
Flash Point is now live on Steam! ːsteamhappyː

After weeks of bug fixing and performance testing, we are finally ready to open the experience to the public.
This game has been a major project for a long time, and it still has a long way to go before we leave Early Access.
If you spot any issues with the gameplay or you want to suggest something, please use our discussions board.

We hope to see you ingame! 
-Aero Games
